title: Is the stream healthy?
summary: Three read-only calls, all allowed by the read-only allowlist. The agent also says what the server cannot tell it.
caveat: This shows the output is active, bytes are moving (compare bytes across two calls) and the renderer keeps up. It does not show network drops, bitrate or reconnects: the server has no such field today, so an agent should not claim them.

note: Is the stream output running, and is it moving bytes?
Has the renderer dropped frames? A zero timeout makes wait_for a one-shot check.
